clips.title: The story
paras: A Stack of Letters has come through the mountain pass into Coldridge Valley. The bundle is meant for scouts stationed in the snowy wilderness.

Mail for Coldridge Valley comes from Anvilmar by way of travelers crossing the pass. The journey to the remote camps in Dun Morogh's mountains is hard, and postal runners rely on travelers to carry letters onward. This bundle is bound for scouts deeper in Coldridge Valley. Talin Keeneye, at his lakeside camp, is thought to be its only recipient until the letters are sorted. Among them is a missive for Grelin Whitebeard, a mountaineer.
